Name: The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades
Author: duijiangyaoyue
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][size=6][b]About This Mod[/b][/size]
The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades turns weapons into companions that speak, remember you, and grow with you.
You meet the Silverfrost Blade near the mine entrance and talk with its spirit, Frost. Through choices, daily conversations, and time spent together, she awakens new forms and skills. The Sevenfold Staff offers a completely different combat style, and its spirit Raven has her own daily life and story. If Cloudcutter is installed, the Spirit Arms Archive also shows Cloudcutter's bond record.
This is not just a weapon mod. It builds a full loop around spirit arms:[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Raise spirit arms in the mines and in daily life[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Build bonds through conversation and choices[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Unlock skills, elements, and new combat styles[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Read growth records in the Spirit Arms Archive[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Enter the Sevenfold Trials and challenge guardians[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Exchange trial tokens for upgrades and supplies[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Grow your own spirit arms alongside friends on the same farm[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]Three Spirit Arms[/size][/b][/font]

[heading][font=Times New Roman]Frost / Silverfrost[/font][/heading]
[font=Times New Roman]The spirit of the Silverfrost Blade.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Grows with mine depth: evolves at 20 / 60 / 100 / 120 floors[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Unique stages, skills, sword energy, and bond[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Active and awakening skills use the sword-energy loop[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Daily conversations rotate by stage and variant; choices change the response[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][heading][font=Times New Roman]Sevenfold Staff[/font][/heading]
[font=Times New Roman]The staff that houses Raven.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Sold by the Adventurer's Guild[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Seven elements: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each element has its own normal attack form and side effect[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Mana, active, passive, and awakening skills[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Normal attacks aim with the mouse, range 0.75–12 tiles[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Five stages, each with its own weapon, name, and sprite[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][heading][font=Times New Roman]Cloudcutter[/font][/heading]
[font=Times New Roman]The spirit from the Cloudcutter mod.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]When Cloudcutter is not installed, its archive page is hidden[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]When installed, Cloudcutter keeps only its Bond page in the archive[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Bond, stage, and dialogue state are read from Cloudcutter's actual data[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]The Cloudcutter trial is entered from Cloudcutter's own menu[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]Spirit Arms Archive[/size][/b]
Press G to open the archive.
The archive has three levels:[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Select a spirit arm: Frost, Sevenfold Staff, or Cloudcutter[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Select a section: Overview / Skills / Trial / Guardian / Bond / Trade[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Enter the original skill loadout menu[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]The archive shows the current blade name, spirit name, and staff name; renames update immediately. Cloudcutter is hidden when not installed.
[size=6][b]Sevenfold Trials[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Frost and the Sevenfold Staff each have a 20-floor trial.[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Up to 24 monsters alive per floor[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]5 seconds of preparation per floor[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Random monster types and spawn positions[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Time is frozen inside the trial[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Failure resets only the current floor; cleared floors remain cleared[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each cleared floor grants the matching token[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each weapon can enter once per day[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Press G during a trial to open Continue / Skills / Exit[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Floor 20 is a guardian duel[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]The guardian does not end the trial automatically; rewards go to the inventory, then press G to leave[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Monster and guardian health scale with the current weapon stage[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]The HUD shows current alive / total for the floor[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][size=6][b]Guardians[/b][/size][/font]

[heading][font=Times New Roman]Frost Court Oathkeeper[/font][/heading]
[font=Times New Roman]The guardian of the Frost Trial.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Blue heavy slash and guard / break mechanics[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Unique sprite and four-frame animations[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Ground and character telegraphs[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Top-screen health bar[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][font=Times New Roman]Sevenfold Astral Arbiter[/font][/size][/heading]
[font=Times New Roman]The guardian of the Sevenfold Trial.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Elemental shield and element-switching mechanics[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Unique sprite and four-frame animations[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Graphical telegraphs and top-screen health bar[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Tied to the staff's element system[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Guardian visual size, ground shadow, and collision are aligned; the health bar does not cover the toolbar.[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][size=6][b]Trade and Growth[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Tokens: Frost Seal and Sevenfold Stardust[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Value is balanced around 1 token ≈ 100g[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]The exchange catalogue includes sprinklers, soil, fertilizer, ore, gems, food, and combat supplies[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each weapon-specific upgrade can be exchanged only once[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman] Guardian gold and materials scale with weapon stage[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Rewards go directly into the inventory; overflow drops at the player's feet[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][size=6][b]Spirit Arms Synergy and Link Stories[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Carrying any two spirit arms triggers synergy[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Default synergy cap is 1; GMCM can set it to 0–2[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Synergy adds one extra attack and does not replace player input[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Carrying all three spirit arms triggers a three-person story based on the held weapon[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each three-person story has 18 pages in two 9-page acts, with three choices per act· [/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Two-person combinations differ by the initiating weapon; there are 6 sets, each with 18 pages[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each set triggers once; after reading, T returns to personal daily dialogue[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Frost × Raven is prioritized for their two-person story; only the three-person story includes all three[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]Multiplayer[/size][/b][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Each player's spirit-arm progress, tokens, trial records, and daily entries are stored independently[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Trial monsters are counted and cleared by owner[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Players do not advance each other's floors[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]A player's trial keeps the same single-player rules and reward settlement[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]Controls[/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Keyboard: T talk, G Spirit Arms Archive, C staff skill menu[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Controller: LB + Y talk, LB + X archive, LB + B staff skill menu[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Talk only responds while holding the matching spirit arm and while no menu or event is active[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Right-click is no longer blocked by this mod; the staff is not a sword-type weapon[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Install Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.0+[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Place the whole The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades folder into Mods[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Optional: install Cloudcutter[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Launch the game and claim the starter chest beside the mine elevator on your first mine visit[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]When upgrading, delete the old mod folder first, then install the new version. Save data is stored in SMAPI save data and is not removed with the folder.[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Supports SVE / RSV / FTM monsters and locations[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Does not modify vanilla maps or existing weapons; safe for existing saves[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Works alongside Cloudcutter for its bond and link content[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]Back up saves when using other mods that change weapon data[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]Known Issues[/size][/b][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]The Cloudcutter page is hidden when Cloudcutter is not installed. This is intended.[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]The trial locks the weapon held at entry; switching weapons switches back automatically. If the weapon leaves the inventory, the trial ends and the current floor is cleared.[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]In multiplayer, each player's trial progress is independent. Multiple players may enter the same trial map, but floors and rewards are settled per owner.[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]关于这个模组[/size][/b]
灵兵契·万刃物语把武器变成会说话、会记得你的同伴。
你会在矿洞入口遇见银霜之刃，与剑灵「霜」交谈、做选择、积累羁绊。随着矿洞深度与日常相处，她会觉醒新的形态与技能。七曜法杖带来另一套完全不同的战斗方式，而它的剑灵「墨羽」也有自己的日常与故事。若安装了裁云模组，灵兵档案里还会出现裁云的羁绊记录。
这个模组不只增加一把武器，而是围绕“灵兵”建立了一整套循环：[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]在矿洞与日常中培养灵兵[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]通过交谈与选择积累羁绊[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]解锁技能、元素与新的战斗方式[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]在灵兵档案里查看成长记录[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]进入七曜试炼，挑战守关者[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]用试炼代币兑换强化与物资[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]与朋友在同一座农场里各自培养自己的灵兵[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]三位灵兵[/size][/b][/font]

[heading][b][font=Times New Roman]霜 / Silverfrost[/font][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]银霜之刃的剑灵。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]随矿洞深度成长，20 / 60 / 100 / 120 层逐步进化[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]拥有独立阶段、技能、剑势与羁绊[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]主动与觉醒技能围绕剑势循环[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]日常对话按阶段与变体轮换，选择会得到不同回应[/font][/*]
[/list][heading][b][font=Times New Roman]七曜法杖 / Sevenfold Staff[/font][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]墨羽寄宿的七曜法杖。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]在冒险家公会出售[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]金、木、水、火、土、风、雷七种元素[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]每种元素有独立普攻形态与附加效果[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]拥有法力、主动、被动与觉醒技能[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]普攻鼠标瞄准，射程 0.75–12 格[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]五个阶段，每阶拥有独立武器、名称与贴图[/font][/*]
[/list][heading][b][font=Times New Roman]裁云 / Cloudcutter[/font][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]来自 Cloudcutter 模组的剑灵。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]未安装裁云时，灵兵档案不显示裁云页[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]安装后，裁云在灵兵档案中只保留羁绊页[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]裁云羁绊、阶段与交谈状态读取裁云模组的实际数据[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]裁云试炼从裁云自己的菜单进入[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]灵兵档案[/size][/b]
按 G 打开灵兵档案。
档案分为三层：[/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]选择灵兵：霜、七曜法杖、裁云[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]选择栏目：总览 / 技能 / 试炼 / 守关者 / 羁绊 / 兑换[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]进入原有技能装配菜单[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]档案会显示当前剑名、剑灵名与法杖名；改名后立即同步。裁云未安装时隐藏裁云页。
[b]七曜试炼[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]霜与七曜法杖各自拥有 20 层试炼。[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每层最多同时存在 24 只怪物[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每层开始有 5 秒准备时间[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]怪物类型与出生位置随机[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]试炼内时间冻结[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]失败只重置当前层，已通过层数保留[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每通过一层获得对应代币[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每把武器每天可进入一次[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]试炼中按 G 打开继续 / 技能 / 退出菜单[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]第 20 层为守关者单挑[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]击败守关者后不自动退出；奖励入包后按 G 手动离开[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]小怪与守关者生命值随当前武器阶段提升[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]HUD 显示「当前存活 / 本层总数」[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]守关者[/size][/b][/font]


[heading][b][font=Times New Roman]霜庭守誓者[/font][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]镇守霜之试炼的守关者。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]蓝色重斩与格挡 / 破防机制[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]独立贴图与四帧动作[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]地面与角色身上的图形预警[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]横跨屏幕顶部的生命条[/font][/*]
[/list]
[heading][b][font=Times New Roman]七曜司辰[/font][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]镇守七曜试炼的守关者。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]元素护盾与元素切换机制[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]独立贴图与四帧动作[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]图形预警与顶部生命条[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]与七曜法杖的元素系统对应[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]守关者的视觉尺寸、脚底阴影与碰撞范围都经过对齐，生命条不遮挡工具栏。[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b]兑换与成长[/b]
代币：霜华令、七曜星砂[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]约 1 枚代币 ≈ 100 金价值[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]兑换目录包含洒水器、土壤、肥料、矿石、宝石、食物与战斗补给[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每把武器的专属强化每项只能兑换一次[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]守关者奖励金币与素材随武器阶段提高[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]奖励直接进入背包；背包满时掉在脚边[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b]灵兵协同与联动剧本[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]任意两把灵兵同时携带即可触发协同[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]协同上限默认 1，GMCM 可调 0–2[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]协同只补一次攻击，不替代玩家操作[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]同时携带三把灵兵时，手持谁就触发谁的三人剧本[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]三人剧本各 18 页，分 9+9 两幕，每幕 3 个选择[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]双人组合按起手武器区分，共 6 套，每套 18 页[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每套只触发一次；全部读完后 T 回到个人日常[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]霜×墨羽双人剧本优先配对；三人剧本才会三人同场[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]多人联机[/size][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]每名玩家的灵兵进度、代币、试炼记录与每日次数独立保存[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]试炼怪物按玩家归属统计与清除[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]不会互相推进层数[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]同一名玩家的试炼仍保持单人规则与奖励结算[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]操作[/size][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]键盘：T 交谈，G 灵兵档案，C 法杖技能菜单[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]手柄：LB + Y 交谈，LB + X 灵兵档案，LB + B 法杖技能菜单[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]只有手持对应灵兵、且不在菜单或事件中时，交谈键才会响应[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]鼠标右键不再被本模组屏蔽；法杖不是剑类武器[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][b][size=6]安装[/size][/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]安装 Stardew Valley 1.6.15 与 SMAPI 4.0+[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][font=Times New Roman]将压缩包内的 The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades 整个文件夹放入 Mods。（[/font]可选安装 Generic Mod Config Menu 和 Cloudcutter）[/font][/*]
